text_block_list.text:
It's the day before the Satsuki Sho, and
Narita
Taishin encounters a redheaded
girl just as small
as her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин finds herself under a
barrage of
comments telling her that no
one expects
anything from her or thinks
she can win. Then the
girl asks if all of
that makes her want to give up.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин responds that she won't
give up
just because of other people's
opinions and that
she'll put everyone to
shame with her running.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The next day, as if to make good on her
words,
Нарита Таисин shows up to race
with an intensity
that overwhelms her
two rivals.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
